summary: Tests-only red phase for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI client). Committed: (1) iOS/Tests/OpenAPIClientTests/ — 7-test contract suite exercising every generated-client surface (manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results, 404 case) entirely against StubURLProtocol stubs, grounded in the real published spec from viamin/color_matching#110 (closed by #113) and upstream controller rendering code; (2) swap-invariant wrapper regression tests added to the declared ColorMatchingLPSAppTests target; (3) docs/color-matching-openapi-client.md — the executable-spec conventions (vendored operation IDs, schema enrichment, package wiring) plus the 15-row contract-delta table and endpoint-gap findings for the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so no Swift test executed locally; iOS CI (macOS runner, swift test) is the execution evidence. Implementation-phase criteria are recorded as not_run pending the paid-tests-approved run, which must declare OpenAPIGeneratedClient/OpenAPIClientTests targets per the doc.
